instruction: Candid wedding photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. Outdoors on a daytime street with a blurred white van and motorbikes in the background. The bride in the white wedding dress (R1) stands on the left, holding a bouquet of white tulips with her head tilted down, eyes closed, and a soft smile. The groom in the black suit (R2) stands on the right, leaning in to gently kiss her forehead. Her arm remains linked through his as they share this intimate moment. The lighting is soft and natural, casting a warm glow over the couple.
